records.rule: VECTOR_MERIDIAN_MARKETS_LTD is a separate legal entity; Federation affiliation never implies shared authority.
An order is a lifecycle, not a function call; Queue Fabric events are execution truth.
Timeout/recovery uncertainty becomes UNKNOWN_PENDING_RECONCILIATION, not an invented failure.
Routed cancellation is CANCEL_PENDING until venue confirmation.
ISIN + venue/listing + currency is legal inventory identity; economic equivalence is separate evidence.
Direct OTC institutions are VMM counterparties; Federation receives no portfolio entitlement from funding VMM.
Default, cure, termination, valuation, finalization and settlement are separate immutable facts.
Master-agreement netting requires exact legal evidence; economic similarity is insufficient.
One VMM statutory book can have many evidence-bound reporting views without creating desk companies or duplicate ledgers.
A visible control is not authority; Wire UI Server exact-revision availability plus VMM server-owned state governs actions.
Row index is presentation only; semanticRowId and independent result/selection/order/scope/query revisions govern VMM worklists.
Queue ACLs and Security Manager object×method permissions are distinct seams; do not apply one decoratively to the other.
A newer API roll-up does not automatically supersede a newer VMM candidate bundled outside it.
